verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for an email service, but the evidence pack never documents retention policies, auto-delete settings, or account or data deletion controls. The pages listed cover filters, masked email, undo send, import and JMAP, none of which describe retention or deletion. A user's anecdote that support restored mail they deleted by mistake concerns recovery, not user-controlled retention, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
